changes: The full changelog is available in every supported language.
Tooth and Tail is now available in the signed integration catalog.
Added support for Tooth and Tail in story missions and local matches against bots.
Opening the overlay keeps the game in focus.
Integration packages now carry signed translations for cheat names, descriptions and resource lists.
Fixed English text in Tinykin controls when using Brazilian Portuguese or Spanish.
New integration translations appear in the app and overlay without requiring another Hub update.
Light and dark themes, with the Windows theme followed by default and a saved appearance setting.
Named cheat profiles per game, including saved multipliers and automatic activation in new sessions.
Translations now use English source messages, shared language files and separate files for each game.
Fixed overlay scrolling so only the cheat list scrolls, without leaving a large empty area.
Fixed in-game disconnects caused by slow Windows process checks and temporary communication file locks.
Artwork for games added through packages, such as Out of Space, now loads automatically in the catalog.
The app and website are available in Portuguese, English and Spanish, with a saved language preference.
Shared translation files and a guide for contributing new languages.
Shake it Co! cover and header artwork are now bundled with the app to prevent catalog image failures.
Shake it Co! received coin and soul balance controls, easy fishing, a frozen day/night cycle, automatic perfect chests and a movement multiplier.
Signed packages can provide balance-setting actions, including zero, with independent values for each control.
Fixed scrolling on the My Little Universe page, which could move the entire window and leave a large blank area.
The sidebar, header and footer stay accessible while browsing long cheat lists.
My Little Universe received 15 controls for health, resources, combat, fishing and multipliers.
Compatible signed packages can define multipliers and inventory actions.
Inventory changes respect native special-item limits to protect saved resources.
The app catalog now shows only games with available trainers, including search results.
New game requests are now made on ByteTrainer's Discord.
The Confirmed games tab lists the 14 upcoming supported titles.
If Steam cannot detect the game, the integration panel now offers a shortcut to locate its folder.
Trainer Hub is now called ByteTrainer.
Update the integration on the game's page. The app downloads and verifies the signed package, then applies it with the game closed.
Installation folders and Steam detection are now configured on each game's page.
The Hub can add games and controls from compatible signed packages without reinstalling the app.
Settings now include a manual check for Hub updates.
Click the version at the top to view the changelog. It also opens the first time you run each version.
Pumpkin Jack and Moventure are now publicly available, with cheats, shortcuts and overlay support.
Moventure received invincibility and infinite jumps.
Invincibility now also prevents knockback and falls caused by attacks.
Pumpkin Jack received health, jump, speed, damage, crow cooldown and collectible tracking controls.
Added a speed slider and fixed the movement limit being reset by the game.
App updates through GitHub Releases and a signed integration catalog through GitHub Pages.
